results.scope: Agreement with saved reference questions; see review limitations
referenceLimitations: Single source-assisted reviewer without independent expert adjudication.
Public puzzles and courses are selected examples, not a population sample. Classical rows are selected error and close-alternative strata.

A clear source move outside the search candidates may lower end-to-end recall. Individual named motifs are selectively reviewed, with unknown entries excluded. Position-character reference is a small partial subset.
Positional negatives denote no separate strategic justification or mechanism supported in the reviewed comparisons.
limitations: Case-level Wilson intervals do not correct for correlated source games.
Unlabelled motifs and uncertain dimensions are excluded, not treated as negatives.
Old live root motifs are a proxy for tactical position character; the old system has no equivalent independent positional/mixed position dimension.
Old mistake nature does not expose a comparable named-motif inventory here; its empty motif prediction is not a motif-accuracy claim.
Conditional capture-refutation motifs remain outside root motif scoring.
